summary: Example NX-API task backs up the NX-OS config, passing proxy_env from group_vars to the task environment.
questions: How do I pass proxy settings to an NX-API task?

answer_card.title: NX-API task with proxy
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup current switch config (nxos)
  cisco.nxos.nxos_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_nxos_location
  environment: "{{ proxy_env }}"
  when: ansible_network_os == 'cisco.nxos.nxos'
```
